eli: FYI - started seeing brief stutters on multi-node tensor-parallel runs after the kernel-selection change yesterday. jobs briefly stall for ~10-30s then resume. reproducible on 8xA100-40GB with batch-size mix. :thinking:
maria: hmm, is this the kernel fallback path we added for matmul tiling? any logs from the kv cache layer? @eli
eli: yes suspecting kv cache timing. logs show repeated `KV_FETCH_TIMEOUT` at different ranks. not consistent which rank, seems to rotate. attached small trace below.
jason: can you paste the trace snippet? also which runtime flags you used?
eli: runtime args: `--tp 8 --batching=dynamic --kernel-policy=latency-first --kv-cache=enabled`
eli: trace tail:
```
[2026-03-01T14:12:02.123Z] rank=3 KV_FETCH_TIMEOUT seq=1024 wait_ms=5000
[2026-03-01T14:12:12.130Z] rank=5 KV_FETCH_TIMEOUT seq=2048 wait_ms=5000
[2026-03-01T14:12:22.145Z] rank=1 KV_FETCH_TIMEOUT seq=3072 wait_ms=5000
[2026-03-01T14:12:22.146Z] compute resumed, token=last
```
anya: interesting. could be an all-reduce/comm overlap regression that delays KV roundtrips. did the kernel selector change alter comm scheduling?
maria: we changed kernel ordering to prefer cuBLASLt matmul when seq_len<1024 which reduced latency, but it also changed how we schedule async collectives for KV barrier. possible we introduced a contention window.
jason: ran a quick perf profile on a repro cluster. saw spikes where NCCL injects 20-40ms of extra latency periodically during the KV fetch path. not full hang but enough to push the fetch over timeout.
jason: snippet from perf timeline (simplified):
```
compute 0-120ms
async allreduce start 120ms
kv fetch request 125ms
nccl wait 130-160ms  <-- variance jumps
kv fetch response 170ms (timeout if >150ms)
```
eli: that matches. so not a deadlock, more like timing variance + conservative KV timeout.
sre-bot: deploy-note: yesterday's runtime push 2026-03-01T02:00 included kernel-selector v2.3 and batching heuristic change `dynamic->aggressive`. rolling-restart began at 02:10 and completed 02:30.
maria: aggressive batching increases overlap density, could amplify contention windows. we probably need to adjust KV timeout or change comm placement.
anya: quick mitigation: increase kv fetch timeout to 250ms and throttle aggressive batching concurrency to avoid bursts. we can test on staging.
eli: trying config tweak now on staging: `--kv-timeout-ms=250 --batching-concurrency=4`
devbot: staging run started (job id st-992). initial run shows a few stutters but no full timeouts in first 30 minutes. :thumbsup:
jason: next step: capture NCCL traces with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and use nvtx around kv fetch to see exact overlap. also collect microbenchmarks for matmul variants to ensure kernel change still wins on latency.
maria: also file a regression ticket to revert kernel-policy quickly if needed. but prefer targeted fix: comm scheduling + kv timeout tune + batching guard.
eli: opening ticket INC-2026-187 with repro steps and links to staging logs. tagging @anya @jason for follow-up.
anya: I'll own the investigative PR to change comm insertion points and add a guard that avoids starting heavy allreduce within X ms of the kv fetch window.
jason: I'll attach perf traces and NCCL dumps to the ticket.
eli: thanks all. please add short notes to the ticket when you try experiments so we can roll forward safely. :eyes:
maria: agreed. if staging holds for 2 hours without timeouts we'll consider gradual prod rollback of batching heuristic.
eli: ok updating ticket now.
